info.name: Chariot FDX Accounts Giving Pools API

params.name: donor_account_id
params.description: Filter Giving Pools by the ID of the associated [Donor Account](/api/donor-accounts).

params.name: page_limit
params.description: The number of results to return. Defaults to 10, max is 100.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A token to retrieve the next page of results.

items.docs:
Returns a list of Giving Pools accessible to the authenticated DAF account.

Giving Pools represent individual named giving pools within a donor's DAF account (e.g. "Smith Family Fund").
A [Donor Account](/api/donor-accounts) may be associated with multiple Giving Pools.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique ID of the Giving Pool.

items.docs: Retrieve a Giving Pool with the given ID.
